newsitem.title: USA: Video Lottery studying holder proposal.
newsitem.headline: Video Lottery studying holder proposal.

text.p: Video Lottery Technologies Inc said on Monday it was studying an offer it received late last week from an investor group led by shareholder and director William Spier to acquire the company's shares for $6 a share.
The offer was for all the Video Lottery shares the group does not already own, the company said.

The company said that the offer is subject to a number of contingencies, including financing, and that no decision had been made whether to sell Video Lottery, although it continued to explore a possible transaction involving its subsidiary, Automated Wagering International Inc.
The company said it was awaiting information from William Spier to enable it to evaluate the bid.
